checked.target: src/sim/car.ts groundUnderBody (C027): arithmetic and order of ts
checked.how: Compared old loop over [-1e-6, -r.length] with the new explicit lip/foot. Same expressions ((-1e-6 - along)/rate, (-r.length - along)/rate), same |t| < half test, same push order (lip then foot, per ramp in track.ramps order). visualPose's hull search breaks ties by index, so order matters and is preserved.

Read it: the first four statements set out.h/gx/gz/ramp to 0/0/0/null before any ramp is tested, so a reused object gives the same result as the old default `{h:0,gx:0,gz:0,ramp:null}`. groundUnderBody reads only `.h`, copied into the `hs` number array, so nothing aliases the scratch.

Grep and full read of car.ts: `ground` appears only at 207 (new), 371 and 581. 371 and 581 each call groundAt(..., ground) and use local `g` straight away. Between that call and the last read of `g` only hitRampFace, resolveContact, restingTop and contactBox run; none reach carView or groundUnderBody. So a stale value in `ground` cannot reach the sim.

Grep over src/: carViews called at world.ts:122, game.ts:183 (after stepWorld in tick()), game.ts:237 (startRace), replay.ts:142 (after the replay loop). bot.ts never calls carView or groundAt, and bots run before stepWorld. No call occurs inside stepCars/moveWithCollisions/updateVertical.

G3 passes (5 replays exact); replay-states.json contains `pitch` and runReplay() returns carViews(world), so pose is compared. tests/sim/replay.test.ts runs 6000 ticks x 3 cars live and replayed and compares fingerprints and end carViews. tests/sim/ramp-pose.test.ts calls carViews after every stepWorld over the Dust Bowl ramp, as the game loop does. G1 605/605.
